summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class tests. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. The TP and D terms use an equivalent O(batch x voxels) form rather than the literal double sum. The stored matrix is cast to the probability dtype as well as device. The numpy, max-2 normalization, non-square, and reduction criteria are verified by reading only, not by tests.
